sources_considered.why: Primary architecture disclosure examined; it does not provide a direct test of whole-object representations.
A retrospective technical review distinguishes diffusion generation from a simple neighboring-pixel account, but does not directly inspect Sora's internals.

evidence_items.explanation: The review describes iterative denoising of compressed visual representations. It provides a competing architectural account, but its reconstruction from public information does not settle whether the original model contains whole-object representations.

unresolved_gaps: No direct representation study of the original Sora was found.
The available architectural descriptions do not establish that dependencies are restricted to nearby pixels.
A diffusion objective neither proves nor rules out learned whole-object representations.
